overview: FMS Pro is a production-ready Student Fee Management CRM SaaS built for educational institutes. It manages the full lifecycle from lead capture to student enrollment, EMI tracking, payment approval, and automated reminders — with role-based access for Admin, Team Head, Counselor, and Accountant.
features: Role-based panels for Admin, Team Head, Counselor, and Accountant
Lead management with auto-assignment to teams by course category
Lead to student conversion with full fee inheritance
EMI plan generation with automated due reminders
Payment approval workflow — Accountant verifies and generates receipts
Revenue, Lead, and EMI reports with PDF/Excel export
Team management with round-robin lead distribution
Activity log tracking all user actions
Modern glassmorphism SaaS UI with responsive layout
